# StudyOS AI Search Summary (llms.txt)

StudyOS is an AI-powered study planner and homework tracker designed for students. It combines automated schedule generation, OCR note transcription, and personalized AI tutoring into a single platform.

## Frequently Asked Questions
Q: Is StudyOS free to use?
A: Yes! You can sign up and start using StudyOS for free. We offer a generous free tier that allows you to manage your homework and try out our AI tutor.

Q: How does the AI Note-Taker work?
A: You can upload your PDFs, paste text, or even snap a photo of your textbook. Our AI instantly reads the content, summarizes it, and can automatically generate flashcards and quizzes.

Q: How does the Smart Homework Tracker differ from a regular calendar?
A: Unlike a static calendar, our tracker acts as your personal academic assistant. Once you upload your syllabus, it dynamically schedules study sessions and adjusts if you fall behind.

Q: Can I use StudyOS on my phone?
A: Absolutely! StudyOS is designed to work perfectly on your phone's browser with a fully responsive layout, making it easy to review flashcards and check your schedule on the go.

Q: What subjects does it support?
A: StudyOS supports virtually all subjects. Because the AI learns from the notes and PDFs you provide, it adapts perfectly to anything from AP Biology to Graduate level Law.
